retainedEvidence.measures: Private restrictive staging and safe archive extraction. No traversal/absolute/device/FIFO/socket hazards. Explicit symlink, hard-link, and sparse rules. Extracted tree equals the signed full-tree path/type/mode/length/digest closure.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform and supported filesystem, a digest-pinned hostile-archive input, the staging-root identity, the extracted tree as path/type/mode/length/digest, and a typed refusal record for each file-04 hazard class (traversal, absolute, device, FIFO, socket, escaping symlink, hostile hard-link, sparse-as-full). Each extracted file sha256 equals the signed TreeCommitment entry. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Extracted bytes equal verified TreeCommitment bytes. Hazard classes refuse. Staging is private and restrictive. This member does not score G15 AT-8 / AT-ARCHIVE-* adapter archive-profile identity.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile archive corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: File-04 case/Unicode/link aliases on the executed tree. Live schemas.v11 pathRule uniqueness (relative, forward-slash, NFC-composed, case-sensitively unique AND unique under case-folding and Unicode normalization; no '.' or '..'; no leading '/'; no drive letters; no backslashes; no NUL; no empty segments; symlink targets resolve inside the tree). Admission identity of presented manifest/index/lock bytes remains sha256 of stored bytes.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform and supported filesystem, extracted/executed path-identity records showing that case/Unicode/link aliases cannot resolve to different bytes than the verified tree, plus refusal records for pathRule violations at extract/exec. This member consumes pathRule / RJ-3. It does not author the DR-103 unicode-norm-duplicate fixture. It does not author Windows-only TC-PATH. It invents no JSON canonicalization (ID-DEP-1 remains the signing-preimage owner; encodingRule forbids admission canonicalization). Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Two aliases (case, Unicode, or link) cannot execute different bytes than the verified tree. pathRule violations refuse as executed-tree identity failure. OBL-UNICODE-NORM and OBL-WINDOWS-PATH remain on DR-103.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile path corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Descriptor/identity/open-handle or digest recheck that binds verification to spawn. Entrypoint and runtime-library resolution inside the verified tree. No PATH, loader, shell, live-project, system-runtime, or install-time substitution. Loader and entrypoint replacement.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform, the verified tree digest, the held descriptor or open-handle identity or digest-recheck record from verification through spawn, the executed entrypoint path and digest, and the refusal record when PATH/loader/shell/live-project/system-runtime/install-time substitution or loader/entrypoint replacement would execute different bytes. File 04 permits descriptor/identity/open-handle or digest recheck; a held pathname descriptor is not by itself an immutable snapshot (TCB v45). This member does not own G22 TCB allowlist traces or undeclared libc/framework/cert/font/ICU resolution. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Spawned bytes equal verified bytes. Loader or entrypoint replacement that changes executed identity refuses. G22 retained loader traces are not this member.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile loader corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Directory/inode swaps, concurrent update/remove, and TOCTOU across supported platforms/filesystems, including verify-to-spawn.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform and supported filesystem, race records at extract, canonicalize, verify-to-spawn, and concurrent update/remove, including directory/inode swap between verification and spawn. Each record pins pre-image identity, post-image identity, and the typed outcome (execute the still-verified identity, or refuse). No wall-clock threshold is invented. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: A race that would execute unverified bytes refuses or remains bound to the still-verified identity. Pass all four platforms; waiver requires platform removal.
